statements.statement: The service was mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229
The service was denied under CO-197
The denial was because required prior authorization was not obtained
The patient has recurrent palpitations and dizziness
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Monitoring was ordered to evaluate the frequency and hemodynamic impact of arrhythmic events
Monitoring was ordered to correlate arrhythmic events with the patient's giddiness
